name: Creative Devices, Inc.
old_description: Specializing since 1970 in Microscopy, Probe Stations, Semiconductor Test and Semiconductor Materials Analysis
about:
Creative Devices, Inc. is based in Middletown, Delaware. The company traces its roots to 1970 when it was established as Micron Optics, Inc., serving as the Nikon microscope dealer for New Jersey. In 1990, the owners sold the Micron Optics name and transferred the Nikon franchise to Sylvax Scientific, then continued operations under the Creative Devices, Inc. name, shifting focus to semiconductor inspection, test, and materials research.

The company manufactures a range of equipment for semiconductor testing and analysis, including semiconductor probe stations, custom optics and optical systems, infrared inspection systems, Raman spectroscopy microscopes, and emission microscopes. It also designs custom probe stations for high- and low-voltage applications and other unique requirements. In addition to manufacturing, Creative Devices acts as a distributor for microscope optics and related equipment from suppliers such as Mitutoyo, Motic, Prior Scientific, New Wave Research, Meiji, and Princeton Instruments. The firm also offers consulting services for microscope and probe station design, laser trimming, Raman spectroscopy, high-voltage testing, and emissions microscopy.

Creative Devices serves the semiconductor industry, providing probe station and microscopy solutions for inspection, testing, and materials research. Its customers include semiconductor manufacturers and research organizations that require custom optical systems, probe stations, and spectroscopy equipment for applications such as laser trimming, high-voltage testing, and emissions microscopy.

The company emphasizes its decades of experience in probe station and microscope design, offering consulting and custom fabrication to address unique application challenges.
